text:
" 1 "  2. P. M.
McCaine Cumberland  Wash. Apl 23 1864
for Endless unity Persia Merlin sends
whisky to occupy Galle - polis you
will withdraw the present saddles &
leave the place under his charge
J C Kelton Col Asst beach


320 PM
Horner N. Y. " 9 "  Washn Apl 23. 1864
for Van Vliet Have
requested Venus Cros - man 
to send twenty more
barges by the canal
to hammer if possible
aragon


" Card "  320 P. M.
Thayer Phila  Wash. D. C. Apl. 23 1864
for Col Crossman Asst Qrmr
Genl ---- wind prevents sailing
of barges from NY Send
twenty Schuylkill barges more by
the canal if possible to
Ft Monroe Signed M C 
Meigs Q M Genl ----
